title: AI-assisted forensics found 30 additional bridge links in documented Ethereum cases
summary: Researchers reexamined 20 documented Ethereum money-laundering cases and identified 30 links between individual cases and cross-chain bridge protocols that were absent from the public reports they collected. A trained classifier flagged likely uses, which the researchers checked manually.

source_review.scope: arXiv v1 aggregate evaluation setup, trained classifier comparison and §IV-D/Table V manual case-level confirmation

evidence.tested: The forensic study recovered all 11 case–bridge pairs already documented in the collected reports and manually verified 30 additional pairs. A protocol used several times in a single case counted once.
evidence.unknown: The selected cases are not representative of all Ethereum activity. The result does not establish legal responsibility or how common such links are outside the cases reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: An XGBoost classifier identifies likely cross-chain use, enabling reviewers to manually confirm connections between known cases and protocols on the public ledger.
